_comment: Copy this to indexers.json to choose which indexers this install searches.
indexers.json is not committed: which sites you search is your choice, not the
project's. Delete it and the app falls back to every module it can find.
enabled    IDs, in the order results should be interleaved. An ID that nothing
provides is ignored, so removing a module does not break this file.
pluginDirs directories of your own indexer modules, loaded as well as the bundled
ones. A plugin with the same ID as a bundled module replaces it.
MARQUO_INDEXER_DIR does the same thing from the environment.
Writing one: see the contract at the top of sources/__init__.py. A module needs
